projectDescription: A unified Bitcoin payment routing SDK that abstracts Bitcoin L1 and L2 address formats, bridge protocols, and transaction models behind a single developer interface.
keyFeatures: BRID (Bitcoin-Rooted Identity Derivation) — derive all L2 addresses from one secp256k1 public key
routePayment() — single call resolves optimal route, selects bridge, checks liveness, returns execution plan
fetchBalances() — query BTC-denominated balances across Bitcoin L1, Stacks, BOB, Rootstock, and Citrea in parallel
Typed transaction pipelines for every supported chain (BOB, Rootstock, Citrea, Stacks)
Bridge adapters for Rootstock Flyover (BTC↔rBTC), sBTC (BTC↔sBTC on Stacks), and BOB Gateway (BTC↔ETH/wBTC)
Recipient recovery — derive cross-chain identity from any existing on-chain address without signing
No private key handling — SignerAdapter boundary enforces external signing (OWS, MetaMask, etc.)
Peel memo — structured binary tag embedded in every transaction for future indexing
AI agent integration via MCP server (v2 roadmap)
publicApiSurface: buildBobEthTransfer / buildBobTokenTransfer / prepareBobTx / serializeBobTx / encodeBobSignedTx / broadcastBobTx
RootstockFlyoverBridgeAdapter — getPegInPaymentPlan, validatePegInTransaction, pollStatus, getPegoutQuote, depositPegout
NETWORKS / ASSETS / getNetwork / getMainnetNetworks / getTestnetNetworks / getAssetsForNetwork
